symptom: Malformed kind values toString, constructor and __proto__ pass the inherited-property membership check and throw TypeError during field dispatch instead of returning invalid-kind classification.
lesson: Using the in operator for record-kind dispatch accepts inherited Object.prototype names. An invalid JSON record can crash the TypeScript validator and append classifier rather than being rejected as REJECTED_INVALID; schema validation elsewhere does not make this path safe.
guardrail: Use an own-property check such as Object.hasOwn for record-kind lookup. Regression-test toString, constructor and __proto__ through both validateForwardVaultRecord and classifyForwardVaultAppend. Do not treat a thrown exception as a valid vault record or authorize production changes.
